message.content:
Below is a quick‑look list of the **long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the statutory holiday falls on a weekday that is adjacent to a Saturday or Sunday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|---------------|-------|
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (Ontario, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, British Columbia) | Monday | ✔ | Creates a Mon‑Tue long weekend in all those provinces. |
| **Apr 7**  | Good Friday | Friday | ✔ | Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday. |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | ✔ | Monday‑Tuesday‑Wednesday. |
| **Sep 4**  | Labour Day | Monday | ✔ | Monday‑Tuesday‑Wednesday. |
| **Oct 9**  | Thanksgiving | Monday | ✔ | Monday‑Tuesday‑Wednesday. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | ✔ | Monday‑Tuesday‑Wednesday. |

### Holidays that did **not** create a long weekend in 2023

| Date | Holiday | Day | Reason |
|------|---------|-----|--------|
| Jan 1 | New Year’s Day | Sunday | Falls on a weekend. |
| Jul 1 | Canada Day | Saturday | Falls on a weekend. |
| Nov 11 | Remembrance Day | Saturday | Falls on a weekend. |
| Dec 26 | Boxing Day | Tuesday | Not adjacent to a weekend. |

> **Pro‑Tip for your app** – If you want to support province‑specific long weekends, you’ll need to keep a mapping of holidays that vary by province (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day in some provinces, etc.). The table above covers the *federal* holidays that create long weekends across the country in 2023.
